summary.text: A 65-year-old woman with polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy, treatment naive per Table 1, presented with blurred vision in her right eye, logMAR BCVA 0.30 and CMT 708 µm. ICGA at presentation showed a cluster of subfoveal polypoidal lesions and a small inferior lesion. She had no history of hypertension or diabetes mellitus.

Four weeks after the first faricimab injection an unexpected response occurred, with significant enlargement of the inferior macular PED despite reduced SRF and PED height in the fovea and CMT falling to 566 µm. Faricimab was continued with four loadings then a T&E regimen; four weeks after the fourth injection CMT was 411 µm, SRF had resolved and repeat ICGA showed new inferior polypoidal lesions.

Over 12 months of follow-up there was no SRF recurrence, CMT fell to 280 µm, the inferior PED height and width decreased and BCVA was maintained at 0.00. Repeat ICGA at month 12 showed regression of the central polypoidal lesions but two inferior arcade lesions had grown, with no SRF, IRF or FA leakage; the latest interval was 16 weeks.

summary.text: A 66-year-old man with polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy had multiple polypoidal lesions nasal to the fovea on ICGA at presentation and received three monthly ranibizumab injections. He showed a suboptimal response with persistent SRF and was switched to faricimab, with BCVA 0.35 and CMT 316 µm at the time of switching.

Four weeks after the first switch to faricimab an unexpected response occurred, with an increase in inferior PED despite SRF resolution, CMT 232 µm and visual acuity improving to 0.20. Faricimab was continued at 6-8 week intervals and, because of persistent fluctuating SRF, he was switched again to aflibercept with good response.

Over 12 months of follow-up CMT was maintained at 260 µm, a sliver of residual SRF was tolerated, PED height and width gradually decreased and decreased further after aflibercept, and visual acuity at the end of follow-up was 0.26.

summary.text: A 69-year-old woman with right-eye polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy had previously received more than ten aflibercept injections. Because of suboptimal response with persistent SRF she was switched to faricimab, with logMAR BCVA 0.50 and CMT 385 µm before the switch; six weeks after the first injection SRF had resolved, CMT was 302 µm and BCVA 0.3.

After the second and third faricimab doses at 9-week intervals, an unexpected response occurred nine weeks after the third injection, with increased distortion, visual acuity decreased to 0.45, inferior sub-RPE bleeding, inferior PED growth despite resolved sub-foveal SRF and an inferior polypoidal lesion with bleeding on repeat ICGA. She was then treated with faricimab and focal laser with good response.

Over 13 months she received seven aflibercept injections and further faricimab injections in a T&E regimen with intervals up to six weeks and three further focal lasers; agent changes followed her preferences. At the end of follow-up CMT was 358 µm with residual SRF, the PED had fully resolved and visual acuity remained 0.45.

summary.text: A 73-year-old man with right-eye polypoidal choroidal vasculopathy had previously received 12 aflibercept injections at intervals of 4-6 weeks. Despite the short interval he had persistent fluctuating SRF with stable PED and was switched to faricimab, with logMAR BCVA 0.25 and CMT 402 µm before switching.

An unexpected response with increase of inferior PED occurred gradually, starting four weeks after the first faricimab injection and becoming significantly pronounced five weeks after the fourth, despite resolution of central SRF and CMT falling to 279 µm. He was switched back to aflibercept because of the inferior PED growth, with no SRF observed.

Over 15 months aflibercept remained the main treatment, with four faricimab injections given briefly for financial reasons; SRF recurred with faricimab and resolved after returning to aflibercept, with no further recurrences. At the latest follow-up CMT was 305 µm and the unregressed PED height and width had increased under five-week intervals, with final logMAR BCVA 0.3.
